title: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
text: Artists are taking to social media to complain that DistroKid has unceremoniously removed their work without notice. Now DistroKid has confirmed to The Verge that the takedowns are a direct response to claims made by UMG. title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
